text:
sara: Quick sync  deadline pressure on the spring milestone. We need a final, pragmatic MVP cutlist. Candidates: tenant SSO, embeddings cache, model-pinning UI, in-console evals, long-retention telemetry. What’s the least-risk, demoable set?

jamal: My take: ship model-pinning + embeddings cache. Put SSO and in-console evals into an escrow slot (feature-flagged). Telemetry retention can be a v1 add-on.

nina: QA constraints: our window is 9 days. Anything needing >2w blocks the ship. Escrow features must have a clear graduation test so QA can run it quickly.

kevin: Ops: any escrowed feature needs an auto-kill and a runbook entry. If something flaps in canary we must be able to flip a switch in <10m.

maggie: Sales perspective: in-console evals are a strong close signal. If we escrow them, we need a clear pilot pathway and replacement demo scripts so demos still feel credible.

sara: Proposed cutlist: MVP = model-pinning UI + embeddings cache (opt-in canary). Escrow: tenant SSO and in-console evals behind flags with explicit graduation criteria. Defer long-retention telemetry.

jamal: Agree. For the escrow gating, propose template: (A) flag + 5-10% canary, (B) 48h graduation window, (C) perf gates: p95 <= baseline * 1.25, error-rate < 0.5%, (D) auto-disable triggers: 99p latency spike or error-rate > 1% for 10m.

nina: QA will need the dev to attach a short test matrix to the PR: 3 flow scenarios, expected thresholds, and synthetic replay script. Without that QA won't sign off.

kevin: I'll create the kill-switch Lambda and add the auto-disable policy to infra. Ops-bot: open ticket for runbook and automation please.

ops-bot: Created INF-9012: "Escrow kill-switch + auto-disable runbook". ETA 48h.

maggie: I'll draft the pilot messaging and an "evaluations & SSO coming soon" slide. Also a short demo script that omits evals but highlights model-pinning.

sara: Launch criteria PM side: (1) no p50/p95 regressions beyond small deltas (+10ms p50, +40ms p95), (2) net token cost improvement >= 10% after cache, (3) canary stability for 48h. If any fail we abort.

jamal: Dev owners: I'll take SSO escrow; nina will coordinate QA test definitions for evals escrow; kevin owns auto-disable. Everyone add graduation criteria to PRs.

nina: QA ack. We can run graduation smoke in parallel to the canary. Need dev scenarios by EOD tomorrow.

kevin: Ops ack. Will publish runbook and the toggle utility. I'll add an IL-level contact list for 24/7 rollback.
maggie: Sales ack. I'll circulate updated deck and one-pager for pilots.

sara: Action items: (1) jamal + devs: feature flags + PRs with graduation criteria (48h), (2) kevin + ops: kill-switch + runbook (48h), (3) nina: QA matrix + smoke plan (48h), (4) maggie: pilot messaging + updated demo scripts (24h). We'll freeze scope after engineering signoff.

ops-bot: Reminder: milestone freeze in 6 days. Automated reminder will post 48h before freeze. Link: https://redwood-internal/boards/launch-3087710000

sara: Thanks all  keep updates in thread and ping me when signoffs are ready. :rocket:
